SHIPPED: Theme system completely stripped from Whisnap. Committed 19b3fdc.

SIGNIFICANCE: 30 files changed, +71 / -807 lines net. Full removal of lightTheme, ThemeSwitcher component, ThemeMode frontend type, Appearance settings card, theme transition CSS. Rust ThemeMode enum kept (backward-compat deserialization) but default changed to Dark. App.tsx now has a single permanent useEffect with NO cleanup (cleanup would strip darkTheme class in Strict Mode).

KEY PATTERNS FOUND BY REVIEW:
- SettingsSearch.tsx had dangling 'theme' search entry (already a known Whisnap pattern from #6i29i0)
- user-acceptance.test.tsx and SettingsPage.test.tsx had stale theme button assertions
- performance.test.tsx had `getByText('Light')`/`getByText('Dark')` selectors
- QuickAccessPanel.tsx had stale `id: 'theme'` entry
- ContextualHelp.tsx had stale 'Dark mode' tip and 'Appearance Settings' link
- All found and fixed across 4 review rounds

ENABLES: Codebase is clean dark-only. No Appearance settings visible to users.
